item.stem:
The diagram shows Anvi's evening activity strip. Each block is 1 hour. Green is play, blue is study, orange is meal, grey is rest.

Which claim is correct?

options.A: Study lasts 1 hour because study is one colour.
options.B: Study lasts 8 hours because the strip has 8 blocks.
options.C: Study lasts 3 hours because three blue blocks are study.
options.D: Play lasts 3 hours because play sits before study.
